title: C482/442/2012 of SURYA KANT DHASMANA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ANR

paras.text:
MCRC No. 342 of 2012
In
C-482 Petition No. 442 of 2012
Hon'ble U.C.Dhyani, J.

Mr. Sohel Siddiqi, learned AGA for
the State.
 MCRC 342 of 2012 is taken up:
None has appeared for the applicant, even in
the revised call. It is a defective matter.
Court fee has not been affixed on the
mediation application as per report dated
21st May, 2012 of Registrar (Judicial). Thus
defect has also not been removed despite
giving opportunities for the same.
Modification application is, therefore
dismissed for want of prosecution.
 (U.C.Dhyani, J.)
 04.06.2012
Kaushal
